source: If we look back to the days of Abraham Lincoln, one of our greatest leaders, he said that sometimes you need to have a public position and a private position on some issues to drive true progress.
zh: 如果我们回顾我们最伟大的领导人之一亚伯拉罕·林肯的时代，他说有时你需要在某些问题上拥有公开立场和私人立场才能推动真正的进步。

source: This is nothing compared to the lies and equivocation of Donald Trump. And furthermore, it's appalling that Republicans are so willing to throw aside all ideals and cooperate with the Russians, the moment it's convenient for them.
zh: 与唐纳德·特朗普的谎言和模棱两可相比，这算不了什么。此外，令人震惊的是，共和党人在他们方便的时候如此愿意抛开所有理想并与俄罗斯人合作。

source: We have already implemented reforms to the DNC to prevent this in the future. And also, the idea that the nomination was "stolen" is absurd and unfactual.
zh: 我们已经对民主党全国委员会实施了改革，以防止未来出现这种情况。而且，提名被“窃取”的想法是荒谬和不事实的。

source: Any "concern" that Republicans have for Bernie Sanders and his supporters is utterly fraudulent. Furthermore, the incidents these leaks mention are minor and had no effect on the nomination.
zh: 共和党人对伯尼·桑德斯及其支持者的任何“担忧”都是完全欺诈的。此外，这些泄密事件提到的事件都很轻微，对提名没有影响。

source: Where is the investigation into the Russian leaks? Where is the investigation into Trump's blatantly illegal business practices over many years? This is an unprecededented and outrageous act of political interference by the FBI.
zh: 对俄罗斯泄密事件的调查在哪里？对特朗普多年来公然非法商业行为的调查在哪里？这是FBI史无前例、令人发指的政治干预行为。

source: I am deeply concerned by Comey's decision to reopen a settled case, and I'm confident that there are no new revelations here. We're going to focus on our message during the closing stretch of this campaign?
zh: 我对科米决定重新审理已结案件深感担忧，并且我相信这里不会有新的披露。我们将在本次活动的最后阶段重点关注我们的信息？

source: We're going to spend our final day in Florida, rallying the Hispanic, Jewish, and black communities against the outrages of Donald Trump and his campaign.
zh: 我们将在佛罗里达州度过最后一天，团结西班牙裔、犹太裔和黑人社区，反对唐纳德·特朗普及其竞选活动的暴行。

source: We're going to visit Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota. I want us to appear with Bernie Sanders and Barack Obama to push our message on trade, the African-American turnout, and party unity.
zh: 我们要去拜访密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州。我希望我们与伯尼·桑德斯和贝拉克·奥巴马一起出现，以传达我们关于贸易、非裔美国人投票率和政党团结的信息。

source: We're going to visit Colorado and Nevada, and maybe a short stop in Arizona, to rally Hispanic turnout and highlight Trump's outrages for a final time.
zh: 我们将访问科罗拉多州和内华达州，也许会在亚利桑那州短暂停留，以提高西班牙裔投票率并最后一次强调特朗普的暴行。

source: Let's not complicate this too much. The election pivots around Pennsylvania -- we're going to spend our final day in Pennsylvania, with an enormous rally of celebrities and party heavyweights.
zh: 我们不要让这件事变得太复杂。选举围绕宾夕法尼亚州展开——我们将在宾夕法尼亚州度过最后一天，届时将举行由名人和政党重量级人物组成的大型集会。

source: I am the most progressive candidate ever for President of the United States. We are pushing for a higher minimum wage, better health care, immigration reform, and police reform. Tim Kaine stands fully behind that agenda.
zh: 我是美国总统有史以来最进步的候选人。我们正在推动提高最低工资、改善医疗保健、移民改革和警察改革。蒂姆·凯恩完全支持该议程。

source: I made my selection based on who is most qualified to serve as President, should the situation ever arise. Tim Kaine has served as a Governor and a Senator over the couse of many years, and he is a reliably progressive Democrat.
zh: 我的选择是基于谁最有资格在这种情况出现时担任总统。蒂姆·凯恩多年来担任州长和参议员，他是一位可靠的进步民主党人。

source: It turns out that you will be running against Trump, likely with a significant fundraising advantage.
zh: 事实证明，您将与特朗普竞争，很可能具有显着的筹款优势。

source: You are setting yourself up be a mainstream, establishment Democratic candidate. It seemed to work for Obama the last two times.
zh: 您正在将自己定位为主流、建制派民主党候选人。过去两次似乎对奥巴马有效。

source: Analysts and voters detect more of a populist note in your latest political persona.
zh: 分析师和选民在您最新的政治形象中发现了更多的民粹主义色彩。

source: Some wonder if it's just a cynical political ploy, but you get your face on the local news in a lot of places across the country.
zh: 有些人怀疑这是否只是一种愤世嫉俗的政治策略，但你的脸出现在全国很多地方的当地新闻上。

source: It's good to hit back hard, even if a few bloviators question how this affects your "likeability".
zh: 强烈反击是件好事，即使一些吹毛求疵者质疑这如何影响你的“好感度”。

source: Maybe your best bet here is to turn this into a "both sides" partisan story. And it's not as if you're wrong about Bush.
zh: 也许你最好的选择是将其变成“双方”党派故事。这并不是说你对布什的看法是错误的。

source: This story is having a definite effect on your campaign, unfortunately.
zh: 不幸的是，这个故事对您的竞选活动产生了明确的影响。

source: Trump's response to this shooting has been widely criticized by political commentators.
zh: 特朗普对这起枪击事件的回应受到了政治评论员的广泛批评。

source: This answer appeals to your core voters.
zh: 这个答案对你的核心选民有吸引力。

source: This is a standard, non-political response to any tragic event.
zh: 这是对任何悲剧事件的标准、非政治反应。

source: It's not yet clear whether this attack was actually terrorism. Both you and Trump are coming under some criticism for jumping to that conclusion.
zh: 目前尚不清楚这次袭击是否真的是恐怖主义。你和特朗普都因仓促得出这个结论而受到一些批评。

source: Pundits talk a lot about the surprisingly pugnacious and populist tone of your acceptance speech.
zh: 专家们经常谈论你获奖感言中令人惊讶的好斗和民粹主义语气。

source: Pundits detect the standard, Democratic talking points in your speech that will appeal to a wide variety of potential supporters.
zh: 专家们在您的演讲中发现了标准的民主党谈话要点，这些要点将吸引各种各样的潜在支持者。

source: Pundits talk a lot about you eschewed ideology to take the attack to Trump.
zh: 专家们谈论了很多关于你避开意识形态来攻击特朗普的事情。

source: Pundits conclude that your speech was somewhat moderate, unifying, and surprisingly non-controversial. Some just thought it was boring.
zh: 专家得出的结论是，您的演讲有些温和、统一，而且令人惊讶地没有争议。有些人只是认为这很无聊。

source: Tim Kaine is very popular within the party establishment, but less well known in the general public.
zh: 蒂姆·凯恩在党内非常受欢迎，但在公众中知名度较低。

source: Whatever your personal feelings, you must do something to reach out to Bernie Sanders and his legion of supporters.
zh: 无论您的个人感受如何，您都必须做一些事情来接触伯尼·桑德斯和他的支持者军团。

source: People on all sides mostly see you trying to strike a middle path on the "Bernie question".
zh: 各方人士大多认为你试图在“伯尼问题”上走一条中间道路。

source: Even close advisors feel it was probably a mistake to freeze Bernie out so aggressively from the convention, given the backlash that has ensued.
zh: 考虑到随之而来的强烈反对，即使是亲密的顾问也认为如此积极地将伯尼排除在大会之外可能是一个错误。

source: This answer has the expected supporters and detractors.
zh: 这个答案有预期的支持者和反对者。

source: This is a safe, standard response and your visit makes you look statesmanlike in contrast to Trump.
zh: 这是安全、标准的回应，与特朗普相比，您的访问让您看起来像政治家。

source: Pundits note the surprisingly strong tone of your speech about ISIS.
zh: 专家们注意到您关于 ISIS 的演讲语气出人意料地强烈。

source: It's fine to bring the attack to Trump. Just make sure to mention what you have to offer as well.
zh: 可以将攻击带到特朗普。请务必提及您必须提供的内容。

source: Your best bet is to focus both on Trump's behavior, along with other economic and social issues that Americans and Democrats find important.
zh: 你最好的选择是关注特朗普的行为，以及美国人和民主党认为重要的其他经济和社会问题。

source: You should definitely be discussing pocketbook issues on the trail, but don't forget how unpopular Trump is as well.
zh: 你绝对应该在旅途中讨论钱包问题，但不要忘记特朗普也是多么不受欢迎。

source: You should definitely be discussing your qualifications on the trail, but don't forget how unpopular Trump is as well.
zh: 你绝对应该在赛道上讨论你的资格，但不要忘记特朗普也是多么不受欢迎。

source: This talking point seems to play well among voters, even if it makes party insiders a little nervous about the direction of your potential Administration.
zh: 这个话题似乎在选民中很受欢迎，即使它让党内人士对你的潜在政府的方向有点紧张。

source: George Bush did not leave office as a popular President. Maybe you can make the case that, underneath everything, Trump and Bush aren't so different after all?
zh: 乔治·布什没有以受欢迎的总统身份卸任。也许你可以证明，在一切的背后，特朗普和布什并没有那么不同？

source: You seem to be betting that you can win over disaffected moderates with repeated attacks on Trump's inexperience and behavior.
zh: 你似乎打赌，你可以通过反复攻击特朗普的经验不足和行为来赢得心怀不满的温和派。

source: It's not like anyone is asking you to comment on this, but it could have been an interesting gambit, given the stakes of this election.
zh: 并不是有人要求您对此发表评论，但考虑到这次选举的利害关系，这可能是一个有趣的策略。

source: It's unclear what effect this will have, but it is an interesting move.
zh: 目前还不清楚这会产生什么影响，但这是一个有趣的举动。

source: Can you turn out enough of the base to make up for disaffecting some moderate voters?
zh: 你能拿出足够的支持来弥补一些温和派选民的不满吗？

source: Can you win enough swing voters to compensate for tepid enthusiasm within your base?
zh: 你能赢得足够多的摇摆选民来弥补你的基地内不温不火的热情吗？

source: There's nothing wrong with embracing Barack Obama this fall.
zh: 今年秋天拥抱贝拉克·奥巴马并没有什么问题。

source: Obama emphasizes turnout repeatedly in his speeches across these areas.
zh: 奥巴马在这些领域的演讲中反复强调投票率。

source: There are a few unwanted rumors out there that you and Obama don't totally get along. Unless you wanted those to leak out?
zh: 有一些不受欢迎的谣言称您和奥巴马相处得不好。除非你想让那些泄露出去？

source: You can run a more assertively populist campaign without completely throwing Obama overboard.
zh: 您可以开展更加自信的民粹主义竞选活动，而无需完全抛弃奥巴马。

source: People notice your surpisingly strong tone on global warming.
zh: 人们注意到你对全球变暖问题的强硬态度。

source: Your attack on coal country is what makes the headlines, for better or worse.
zh: 无论好坏，你对煤炭国家的攻击都是头条新闻。

source: This comes off as a very market-focused philosophy in combatting global warming.
zh: 这是一种非常以市场为中心的应对全球变暖的理念。

source: Unfortunately, an ill-timed health issue has cost you several days of appearances during a critical part of the campaign.
zh: 不幸的是，一个不合时宜的健康问题让您在竞选的关键部分缺席了几天。

source: After a couple of days, the health issue recedes to the background.
zh: 几天后，健康问题就退居幕后了。

source: You are campaigning hard, but several times you break out into uncontrolled coughing fits that don't escape public notice.
zh: 你正在努力竞选，但有几次你突然爆发不受控制的咳嗽，这并没有逃脱公众的注意。

source: Unfortunately, your decision to keep campaigning has really backfired. Your health issue has gotten worse, forcing you to take a significant break from the campaign in October.
zh: 不幸的是，你继续竞选的决定确实适得其反。你的健康问题变得更糟，迫使你在十月的竞选活动中大幅休息。

source: Your 30-minute TV spots have terrible ratings, and Trump doesn't hesitate to mock you for it on Twitter.
zh: 你的 30 分钟电视节目收视率很糟糕，特朗普会毫不犹豫地在 Twitter 上嘲笑你。

source: Pundits seem to think that you did surprisingly poorly against Trump, even if he was his usual wild self.
zh: 专家们似乎认为你在对阵特朗普时表现出奇的糟糕，即使他还是平时狂野的自己。

source: Your debate performances are widely praised, especially compared to Trump. Will it matter with the voters?
zh: 你的辩论表演受到广泛好评，特别是与特朗普相比。这对选民来说重要吗？

source: Trump's comments dominate the airwaves for several days, and even bring some condemnation from notable conservatives.
zh: 特朗普的言论连续几天占据了电视广播的主导地位，甚至招致了一些著名保守派人士的谴责。
